entries.german:
Der Abschluß einer Übereinkunft über den abzugsfreien Verbrauch von Pensionen im Ausland; darin Listen und Einzelfälle.
1. Liste (1813)
Sauer, Gregor, ehemals Franziskanerbruder, Metzger, Georg, von Ebrach, ehemals Klostergeistlicher, Roeder, Anna Maria, von Oberschwarzach, Witwe eines Landgerichtsdieners, Bäur, Elisabetha, Schneider, Anselm, von Bamberg, ehemals Dominikanermönch, Rieck, Peter, ehemals Trompeter, Heinz, Melachias, ehemals Klostergeistlicher, Mock, Juliana, von Mittelstein, Korporalswitwe, Basing, Karl, von Bamberg, Karmelitenbruder, Weyer, Stephan, von Ebrach, Klosterbruder, Klein, Anton, von Ebrach, Klosterbruder, Hintereikart, Desiderius, ehemals Laienbruder, Endres, Sebastian, von Rosenberg, Militärinvalide, Ethal, Freifrau von, geborene von Hofenfels, ehemals Obersthofmeisterin. entries.english:
Agreement on duty-free consumption of pensions abroad; includes lists and individual cases.
1st list (1813)
Sauer, Gregor, formerly a Franciscan brother, butcher; Georg, from Ebrach, formerly a monastery cleric; Roeder, Anna Maria, from Oberschwarzach, widow of a district court officer; Bäur, Elisabetha, tailor; Anselm, from Bamberg, formerly a Dominican monk; Rieck, Peter, formerly a trumpeter; Heinz, Melachias, formerly a monastery cleric; Mock, Juliana, from Mittelstein, a corporal’s widow; Basing, Karl, from Bamberg, Carmelite brother; Weyer, Stephan, from Ebrach, monastery brother; Klein, Anton, from Ebrach, monastery brother; Hintereikart, Desiderius, formerly a lay brother; Endres, Sebastian, von Rosenberg, military invalid; Ethal, Baroness, née von Hofenfels, formerly chief court mistress; Rabenau, Baron, Teutonic Order commander; Schmitt, Thomas, formerly a Franciscan monk; Gerhard, from Bamberg, formerly regimental quartermaster; Kunzmann, formerly a lieutenant.
2nd list (1813) and 3rd list (1814):
Gros, Baron, formerly chief administrator in Bamberg; Heuchling, von, widow of a legation secretary, in Regensburg. Schwingenstein, lieutenant’s widow in Schwarzenberg; Schmitt or Schmidt, formerly castellan in Baunach; Gobel, Baroness, major’s widow in Amberg; Münch, formerly abbess in Himmelpforten, in Burgwindheim; Genzler, formerly a nun in Bamberg; Fortenbach, formerly a nun in Bamberg; Schmitt or Schmid, formerly a nun in Bamberg; Fackenhofen, von, major’s widow in Dillingen; Bößner, district councillor in Regensburg; Zillenhard or Zellenhard, von, formerly a nun; Marx, formerly a nun; Wildenstein, formerly a nun; Boxleidner, formerly a nun; Böhm, formerly a nun; Gundermann, formerly a monastery cleric at Heidenfeld, in Burgwindheim; Hardt, formerly a monastery cleric; Sundenmahler or Sündermahler, formerly a monastery cleric; Weier, formerly a nun.
4th list (1814):
Gebsattel, von, dean of the dissolved collegiate foundation of St. Burkard, in Neuburg; Welden, von, from the dissolved collegiate foundation of St. Burkard, in Augsburg; Büttner, nun in Ebrach; Übl, nun in Burgwindheim; Herpig, knight’s messenger, in Nürnberg; Loder, legation councillor, in Regensburg; Brenner, syndic, in Regensburg; Nerl, legation secretary, in Regensburg; Sachs, syndic, in Nürnberg; Übel, land cashier; Mannert, knight’s messenger, in Regensburg; Mehring, secretary in Nürnberg; Moseler, registrar’s widow in Bamberg; Wolkenstein, Countess, minister’s widow, in Clausen in Tyrol; Voith, young lady von, in Bamberg; Killinger, invalid, in Iphofen; Züffl, lieutenant’s widow, in Innsbruck; Krug, in Hollfeld; Goebel, from Ebrach, priest, in Bamberg; Popp, priest, in Bamberg; Guttenberg, von, from Zeil, chief administrator, in Bamberg; Moser, von Knetzgau, chief magistrate, in Bamberg; Werner, von Zell, nun, in Seßlach; Hirschberg, von, regional directorate councillor, in Weihersberg; Hammer, district cashier, in Nürnberg; Frick, hospital cashier, in Iphofen; Gobel, Maximilian von, officer’s son, in Amberg; Gobel, Wilhelm, von, officer’s son, in Amberg.
5th and 6th lists (1814):
Franckenstein, Gabriela von, collegiate canoness in München; Leyden, Karolina von, collegiate canoness in München; Gravenreuth, Viktoria von, collegiate canoness, Sankt Remy de la Perouse; Adelheid Gräfin or Perouse, Adelheid Gräfin Sankt Remy de la, collegiate canoness in München; Lodron, Theresia, Countess, collegiate canoness; Valenti, Karolina von, née Countess von Leiningen, collegiate canoness in Bamberg; Adam, Amalia von, collegiate canoness in Memmingen; Mühlholz, Karolina von, née v. Schwaiger, collegiate canoness in Ried; Gouvier, Luise von, collegiate canoness in München; Manosetter or Monostetter, Eleonore, née von Berger, collegiate canoness in München; Schlierf or Schliers, Anne von, collegiate canoness in München; Miller or Müller, Henriette von, collegiate canoness in München; Hammel, Franziska von, collegiate canoness in München.
